name: Ginger-Scallion Steamed Fish
blurb: Flaky fish, sizzling aromatic oil, a single spoon of soy.
steps: Lay fish on a plate over half the ginger and steam 8-10 min until just flaky.
Pour off the steaming liquid, top with scallion, remaining ginger and cilantro.
Heat oils until shimmering, pour over the aromatics, then drizzle the soy around the fish.

name: Chicken & Ginger Congee
blurb: Silky rice porridge; flavour comes from ginger, not salt.
steps: Simmer rice, broth, 4 cups water and ginger, stirring often, for 45 min.
Add chicken for the last 15 min, then shred it back into the pot.
Finish with scallion, white pepper and a few drops of sesame oil.

name: Garlic Bok Choy
blurb: Five-minute greens with plenty of garlic.
steps: Halve the bok choy and rinse well.
Fry garlic in oil for 30 s, add bok choy and 2 tbsp water, cover 2 min.
Uncover, toss with soy and sugar, and serve right away.

name: Tomato & Egg Stir-Fry
blurb: The home-cooking classic. Tomatoes do the seasoning.
steps: Softly scramble eggs in half the oil; set aside.
Cook tomatoes in the remaining oil until saucy, about 4 min.
Add sugar and salt, fold the eggs back in, top with scallion.

name: Masoor Dal
blurb: Red lentils with a sizzling cumin tempering.
steps: Simmer lentils with turmeric and 3 cups water for 20 min until soft.
Meanwhile fry cumin, then onion, garlic, ginger and tomato in oil.
Stir the tempering into the dal, season, and finish with cilantro.

name: Chana Masala
blurb: Cooking chickpeas from dry skips the salt in canned ones.
steps: Pressure-cook soaked chickpeas 25 min (or simmer 1 hr).
Brown onions in oil, add garlic, ginger and spices, then tomatoes.
Add chickpeas with some cooking liquid and simmer 15 min.

name: Egg Drop Soup
blurb: Low-sodium broth makes a light, satisfying soup.
steps: Bring broth to a simmer; stir in cornstarch slurry to thicken.
Stir the pot in one direction and slowly pour in the eggs.
Season with pepper and salt, finish with scallion and sesame oil.

name: Smashed Cucumber Salad
blurb: Garlicky, tangy and crunchy. Vinegar keeps it bright.
steps: Smash cucumbers with a cleaver and cut into bite-size pieces.
Toss with salt for 10 min, then drain the liquid.
Toss with everything else and serve cold.

name: Rainbow Tofu Stir-Fry
blurb: Crispy tofu and five vegetables in a ginger glaze.
steps: Press and cube tofu, toss in cornstarch, and pan-fry until golden.
Stir-fry vegetables with garlic and ginger until crisp-tender.
Return tofu, add soy and a splash of water, toss to glaze.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
blurb: Dessert that fits the budget.
steps: Steam soaked rice for 25 min.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt; fold most into the hot rice.
Rest 15 min, then serve with sliced mango and the remaining sauce.

name: Sesame Spinach (Sigeumchi Namul)
blurb: A banchan side that's mostly sesame and garlic.
steps: Blanch spinach 30 s, shock in cold water, and squeeze dry.
Toss with garlic, sesame oil and soy.
Top with sesame seeds.

name: Chili-Garlic Edamame
blurb: A snack that's big on flavour and low on salt.
steps: Boil edamame 4 min and drain.
Sizzle garlic and chili in sesame oil for 30 s.
Toss edamame in the oil and finish with a tiny pinch of salt.

name: Steamed Egg Custard
blurb: Gyeran-jjim: puffy, savoury and very gentle.
steps: Whisk eggs with broth and salt, then strain for silkiness.
Steam covered on low for 10-12 min until just set.
Top with scallion and sesame oil.

name: Soy-Ginger Chicken Rice Bowl
blurb: Weeknight rice bowl. Switching to low-sodium soy saves more than a third of its sodium.
steps: Marinate sliced chicken in soy, ginger, garlic and honey for 10 min.
Sear the chicken until cooked through; steam the broccoli.
Serve over rice with a drizzle of sesame oil.

name: Lemongrass Chicken
blurb: Bright and fragrant. Half the fish sauce plus extra lime works.
steps: Marinate chicken in lemongrass, garlic, shallot, fish sauce and sugar.
Sear in a hot pan until caramelised and cooked through.
Squeeze lime over just before serving.

name: Thai Coconut Chicken Curry
blurb: Creamy curry built on aromatics instead of salty paste.
steps: Fry onion, garlic, ginger and curry powder until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and chicken; simmer 15 min, then add peppers.
Season with fish sauce, lime and sugar; finish with basil.

name: Salmon Teriyaki
blurb: Glossy glaze. Most of the sodium comes from the soy.
steps: Simmer soy, honey, ginger, garlic and vinegar into a glaze.
Pan-sear salmon skin-side down 5 min, flip for 2.
Spoon the glaze over and top with sesame.

name: Miso Soup with Tofu
blurb: It looks light, but one bowl is about a third of a 1,500 mg day.
steps: Heat 4 cups water (or dashi) to just below a simmer.
Whisk in miso off the heat; never boil it.
Add tofu, wakame and scallion.

name: Chicken Adobo
blurb: The Filipino classic: vinegar, garlic, and a lot of soy.
steps: Marinate chicken in soy, vinegar, garlic and pepper for 30 min.
Simmer covered 30 min, then uncovered to reduce.
Sear the chicken in its own fat and glaze with the sauce.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice
blurb: Kimchi, gochujang and soy all add sodium to one pan.
steps: Fry kimchi in oil for 3 min, then add gochujang.
Add rice and soy; stir-fry until crisp in spots.
Top with fried eggs, scallion and sesame oil.

name: Kimchi Jjigae
blurb: Warming stew with a very high sodium count.
steps: Brown pork, then add kimchi and fry 5 min.
Add 3 cups water, gochujang, gochugaru, onion and soy; simmer 15 min.
Add tofu and scallion and simmer 5 more min.

name: Takeout-Style Beef & Broccoli
blurb: The takeout favourite, full of oyster sauce and soy.
steps: Velvet sliced beef in cornstarch and half the soy.
Sear beef in batches; blanch broccoli.
Toss with a sauce of oyster sauce, soy, sugar, garlic and ginger.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Kra Pao)
blurb: Street-food favourite with three salty sauces.
steps: Pound garlic and chili; fry in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Add sauces and sugar, then toss in basil until wilted.

name: Mapo Tofu
blurb: Numbing and spicy. Doubanjiang is one of the saltiest condiments.
steps: Brown pork, then fry doubanjiang, garlic and ginger in the oil.
Add broth, soy and tofu cubes; simmer gently 5 min.
Thicken with cornstarch slurry and top with scallion.

name: Pad Thai
blurb: A restaurant portion can exceed a full day's sodium limit.
steps: Soak noodles until pliable.
Stir-fry shrimp, push aside, and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles, fish sauce and sugar; toss with sprouts, scallion and peanuts.

name: Chicken Pho (Phở Gà)
blurb: Most of the sodium is in the broth, so leave some in the bowl.
steps: Simmer broth with charred ginger and onion for 30 min; poach chicken in it.
Season with fish sauce; cook the noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with noodles, sliced chicken, hot broth and herbs.

name: Cold Soba with Dipping Sauce
blurb: Surprise: the noodles themselves contain added salt.
steps: Cook soba 4 min, then rinse hard under cold water.
Mix soy, sugar and 1/2 cup water for the dipping sauce.
Serve noodles topped with nori and scallion, with the sauce on the side.
